scope: Automated Studio Play end-to-end integration and regression suite for firearms (Pistol and SMG)

checks.name: Pistol level gate
checks.expected: Level 1 purchase rejected, coins unchanged at 10000

checks.name: Pistol purchase
checks.expected: Level 3 purchase costs 1400 coins, coins 10000 -> 8600, equipped Pistol

checks.name: Invalid shoot vectors
checks.expected: Zero vector, sub-magnitude, and excessive magnitude rejected without consuming ammo

checks.name: Spam rate limiting
checks.expected: 5 rapid bursts within 0.28s cooldown consume only 1 bullet (11 -> 10)

checks.name: Pistol reload cycle
checks.expected: GunReloading=true for 1.6s duration, refilled 10 -> 12 upon completion

checks.name: SMG level gate
checks.expected: Level 3 purchase of SMG (requires lvl 7) rejected, coins remain 8600

checks.name: SMG purchase
checks.expected: Level 7 purchase costs 4200 coins, coins 8600 -> 4400, equipped SMG

checks.name: Raycast wall obstruction
checks.expected: Wall blocks bullet, target dummy takes 0 damage (health remains 1000)

checks.name: Transparent trigger pass-through
checks.expected: Portal field transparent non-collidable trigger does not block bullets

checks.name: Clear line of fire damage
checks.expected: Target dummy takes 14 damage (health 1000 -> 986) and LastAttacker matches UserId

checks.name: Melee punch remote rejection
checks.expected: Punch remote rejected while holding firearm, dummy takes 0 melee damage

checks.name: Shooting blocked during reload
checks.expected: Shoot requests during GunReloading=true do not consume ammo or fire

checks.name: Weapon switch reload cancellation
checks.expected: Switching weapon cancels GunReloading and prevents premature magazine refill

checks.name: Full SMG reload cycle
checks.expected: GunReloading=true for 2.1s duration, refilled to 24 upon completion

limits: Single-player Play integration; multiplayer network replication under high ping not measured
No live DataStore write (SessionStudio mode maintained)
Audio assets use built-in Roblox sound effects and transients with custom pitch/layering
